race.comment: FLASH INQUIRY (4) brings the clearest race form after a second at Swan Hill where she was beaten just over a length despite having difficulty getting clear near the 400m, and the 1.5kg apprentice claim is another small help. TRICKY MISS (10) debuts for Ciaron Maher. Respecting any support for the strong yard. RED MINK (8) was only narrowly beaten at Albury last start and with further improvement expected, she shapes as one of the major players. STARSEATIC (9) also comes right into play as she should be prominent from the outset.
